caption: The drawing is on a round ceramic plate with a decorative border. The border features detailed illustrations of various types of seashells and marine plants, arranged evenly around the edge. The main central image inside the plate depicts an industrial scene: a building with a gabled roof and tall smokestack stands to the left, accompanied by a large waterwheel. A track or inclined plane runs diagonally from the building toward the lower right, carrying a series of small, connected railcars. Trees and a hilly landscape are visible in the background, with detailed shading that gives depth to the terrain and foliage. The colors in the image are rendered in grayscale, suggesting the image is either a black and white photograph of the plate or the plate itself is decorated in monochrome tones. The entire composition is symmetrical within the circular plate, with the border and central scene occupying distinct areas.
title: Plate - "Baltimore and Ohio Railroad"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
